doc: A timeline's gain automation heard and seen, offline: the curve drives a real audio bus under a reference tone, and a headless omui view shows it frame by frame — a WAV, a contact sheet, an animation and a report.

tools.name: audition.automation
tools.description: One timeline gain curve auditioned on a 220 Hz reference tone, offline (no window or device): a WAV, a PNG sheet, a WebP and a report

file.description: a file or directory path: a timeline: a .timeline.xdef.ts module, or its .timeline.xdef.json

out.description: a file or directory path: the outputs' prefix; its parent directory must exist

fps.description: an exact timeline rate, 1 … 120 (60); the sound is the same
